post.text: 12-year-old Star Wars child actor Jake Lloyd says that he is retiring from acting forever due to nonstop harassment from adult Star Wars fans, including death threats and sexually-explicit messages. https://t.co/owpDv18ujA
post.author_description: Live-posting as a reporter embedded in history. Curated by @MannyMarotta. Companion to @50YearsAgoLive, @100YearsAgoLive, and @250YearsAgoLive. DM for business.

description.description: A close-up shot of a young boy with blond, bowl-cut hair, appearing to be young Anakin Skywalker from Star Wars. He wears a tan, textured tunic over a dark shirt and carries a black backpack with thick straps. He has a concerned or thoughtful expression on his face against a bright, hazy background.
